Manage portfolios & quality profiles

Result:

We investigated together with Tanguy form CBF Platform team and currently the only feasible way is to have an IPEX AD group and manually add with read access to create an IPEX view visibility.

There is no mandatory naming convention which rules out visibility via portfolio filter key to ensure visibility in a good way. Currently there are portfolios with and without IPEX in then name.

The filtering in portfolio is connected to access so that giving read access to some projects and admin to others like we do for repositories in GitHub would not work.

We decided to create an IPEX quality profile so that we can administrate the rules used by IPEX teams. For example, this will solve request to run all available accessibility rules available in Sonarqube but not added to default profile Sonar Way. The new Quality profile is called IPEX way.
